evidence.quote: The primary mission of ZYZZsat is to image the whole Great Barrier Reef in visible bands at 5 m resolution

criteria.reasoning: All introductory requirements are addressed to a very high standard. The coral bleaching rationale is compelling and backed by relevant literature. The single-spacecraft architecture is justified convincingly against revisit requirements. Users, operators, and funding arrangements are explicitly specified.

evidence.quote: The orbit is near-polar and retrograde, so over time the satellite passes over all latitudes up to 82°.

criteria.reasoning: The mission design is technically rigorous and thorough. Orbital mechanics, launch vehicle selection, azimuth calculations, diffraction optics sizing, access duration, data volume budgets, and analytical atmospheric drag decay calculations are accurate, clearly explained, and closely tied to STK outputs.

evidence.quote: ZYZZsat meets the mission needs set out in the introduction with one 50 kg satellite.

criteria.reasoning: The conclusion concisely synthesises core findings and provides an insightful critical appraisal of four genuine engineering limitations (launcher flight heritage, fluid lensing efficacy, ground station modifications, and nadir repeat cycle).

evidence.quote: This report presents the design of ZYZZsat (Z-axis/Y-axis Zeroed Zoning Satellite), a single Earth observation microsatellite for monitoring coral bleaching on the Great Barrier Reef.

criteria.reasoning: The document is structured logically as a professional engineering report. Formatting, tables, equation layout, and figure captions are consistent. The executive summary is comprehensive and IEEE references are properly cited.

requirements.where: Appendix A: STK files and settings

technical_issues.issue: A formal RF link budget (transmit power, G/T, path loss, margin) for the 50 Mbit/s X-band downlink was omitted, as acknowledged.
Mount Pleasant 12 m antenna is primarily a geodetic VLBI dish; slew-rate limits and tracking performance for low-elevation LEO passes should be verified.

overall: An exemplary, technically sophisticated space mission design report. Analytical hand calculations align perfectly with STK simulations and requirements.
